description: This walk takes you from Okehampton to Ivybridge in Dartmoor. The route runs for a distance of just under 40 miles and makes uses of a number of waymarked long distance trails to take you between the two settlements. You'll follow sections of the Dartmoor Way, Tarka Trail and the Two Moors Way as you cross the Dartmoor National Park. As such most of the route takes place on well signposted decent walking trails. On the way you will pass Sticklepath and Chagford with some fine Dartmoor scenery throughout.
